results.title: Gazawyat: Maha
results.overview: The film tells the story of Maha Abu Ammouneh, a displaced mother who, in the heart of genocide, becomes a mother, teacher, doctor, and refuge, reinventing life for her children from nothing through imagination and play to shield them from fear and create a safer world within the ruins.

results.title: Gazawyat: Fidaa
results.overview: The film follows Fidaa Abu Maryam on her journey to wield storytelling as a psychological shield. By gathering the testimonies of Gazan women, she transforms their narratives into a living archive of feminist memory, defying oblivion and reclaiming the self from the heart of the ruins.

results.title: Summer Alone
results.overview: Gage, an orphan, documents her final moments in Adelaide, Australia, before she moves across the world to be with her long-distance partner. As her partner is busy with work, he asks her to make a film for him.

results.title: traipsing blues
results.overview: A photo montage, an internal monologue, a poem of a girl.

results.title: Gazawyat: Hadeel
results.overview: Far from the news, a silent genocide seeks to crush the humanity and femininity of women in displacement camps. The film dives into spontaneous moments of shared storytelling, where displaced women gather to reclaim their selves through ancient rituals. It is their attempt to rebuild the fortress of femininity dismantled by displacement, a bold declaration that the dignity of the body is the enduring reflection of the soul amidst the ruins.

results.title: Gazawyat: Noor
results.overview: The film follows Nour, a Palestinian journalist living through genocide between frontline reporting and displacement, as life inside a tent exposes the fragility of privacy, the body, and marriage, turning her daily existence into a silent struggle for dignity, voice, and humanity under constant threat.

results.title: LYCEUM
results.overview: After the entire student body mysteriously drops out, a young and obedient maths teacher must survive an absurd training session to land the first job he so desperately needs.

results.title: Hopscotch
results.overview: In a room with two entrances and exits, four plinths are arranged at equal distances from one another, forming a square embedded in a corner. On each plinth a number from 1 to 9. A stationary camera is positioned several meters away, angled toward the lower half of the body. The characters enter and exit the room, sometimes interacting with one another and sometimes not.

results.title: Valleys of the Earth
results.overview: Valleys of the Earth is a story of redemption set in a post-apocalyptic United States several years after an enormous solar plunges Humanity into a new Dark Age. From the ashes, a militarized cult known as "the Watchers" rises. Led by their prophets, the Watchers believe this apocalyptic event was brought on by their Angels, and that it is as a means of giving humanity a fresh start. Isaac, our protagonist, attempts to flee his past and right his wrongs. Along the way, his story becomes entwined with Kellen, a young woman fiercely dedicated to upholding a promise she once made. If the two are to survive, they must learn to trust one another; however, the Watchers are everywhere, and will stop at nothing to recover what they have lost.

results.title: Wildgemis
results.overview: Wildgemis is the directorial debut of Anouk Suntjens. Set in the vast American wilderness, the film follows Dutch researcher Elke Tukker, who has spent years studying the lives of wild horses. What begins as a fascination with these free-roaming animals gradually becomes a personal journey into humanity’s relationship with nature. As activists, government agencies and ranchers clash over land management, Elke is confronted with difficult questions about control, freedom and our place within the ecosystem. When she witnesses a controversial horse round-up for the first time, her sense of “wild longing” reaches a breaking point. Wildgemis is a powerful and thought-provoking documentary about nature, power and the human need for connection.

results.title: Beneath the  Skin
results.overview: In the present day, when racism and stereotypes still circulate around the Roma population in Bulgaria, Roma-Bulgarian actress Nataliya Tsekova reveals emotional and compelling stories about her journey to become an actress, and her battles with mis-representation in the film industry.

results.title: A Flowing Symphony
results.overview: Amid the cyclical rhythms of rice cultivation, the soil of Lung Nga Pai in Tai Po whispers its secrets of time, and reveals the subtle tensions and resonances between nature and human presence.

results.title: Angel Infinity
results.overview: A young girl who is a victim of deep-faked porn meets a wage slave young man who creates virtual lover "Angel A" – a budding love story of two lonely souls caught between illusion and reality.
